title: Schedule A (Form 940) for 2025: Multi-State Employer and Credit Reduction Information

passages.question: Is Washington a credit reduction state?
passages.excerpt: Credit reduction states for 2025. The credit reduction rate for California is 0.012 (1.2%). The credit reduction rate for the U.S. Virgin Islands is 0.045 (4.5%). ... You're subject to credit reduction if you paid FUTA taxable wages that were also subject to state unemployment taxes in any state listed that has a credit reduction rate greater than zero.
